messages.text:
"A classic rpg like drakensang online with 100 levels as a limit for the character and differente dungeons across de contient with weekly events to complete and earn rewards to upgrade the equipment.
Put different ways to enhance to equipment such as incrusting gems with different stats like attack speed, movement speed, damage, hit points, critical value etc.
Put seasonal events like easter, christmas, halloween acording to actual date.
Put different jewels that can also be incrusted on equipment with modifiers for the character skills to make it even stronger and make it a co-op game.
"
